FIGURE: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

free_design.Place: A narrow bookshop stair landing with one high window and a warm brass wall lamp, well after dusk.
free_design.Activity: She waits out an evening rain shower, listening intently to droplets in a metal gutter rather than rushing home.
free_design.Pose: She sits upright on a wide stair, torso three-quarter to camera, looking toward the window. Her right hand loosely pinches the end of a small paper bookmark; her left palm rests flat on the stair beside her left hip. Both forearms are visible.
free_design.Framing: Portrait 2:3 at seated eye height, full body including shoes, with the stair rail defocused at the outer edge.
free_design.Outfit: An opaque marigold one-shoulder knit top with an origami-folded cuff on its single sleeve, high-waisted dark teal ankle trousers and flat shoes.
